WITH invoice_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    invoice_number,
    AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS DECIMAL)) as avg_quantity,
    AVG((derived_product_cost - derived_total_cost) / NULLIF(derived_total_cost, 0)) as cost_ratio
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  GROUP BY invoice_number
),
overall_stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_quantity) as overall_avg_qty
  FROM invoice_stats
),
filtered_invoices AS (
  SELECT 
    i.invoice_number,
    i.avg_quantity,
    i.cost_ratio,
    i.avg_quantity - o.overall_avg_qty as qty_difference
  FROM invoice_stats i
  CROSS JOIN overall_stats o
  WHERE i.avg_quantity > o.overall_avg_qty
)
SELECT 
  invoice_number,
  avg_quantity,
  cost_ratio,
  qty_difference
FROM filtered_invoices
ORDER BY qty_difference DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: product_quantity is VARCHAR(50) in the schema but must contain numeric values to compute its average. We cast to DECIMAL.
